content: Logging friction is the top predictor of abandonment in calorie trackers: engagement drops steeply in the first weeks and apps invest heavily in friction reduction (copy meal, favorites, recent foods, quick add, AI photo and voice logging). MacroFactor built a Food Logging Speed Index argument around this; Lose It, Nutrola and WellyPal market the same friction-reduction features. Direct academic search was rate limited; claim is cross-checked from vendor sources only.
